address: Cleaver House, Donegall Square North, Belfast,BT1 5GA
bio: Indulge in a delightful Afternoon Tea at Parisien Belfast, where you can savour delectable treats while enjoying stunning views of the iconic Belfast City Hall. Immerse yourself in the elegant ambience of this chic venue as you sample a selection of freshly baked savouries and delicious sweet treats, creating a memorable and picturesque dining experience in the heart of the city.  Located in the heart of Belfast, this chic venue provides elegant decor and charming ambiance with an inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal spot for gathering with friends or celebrating special occasions in style.  The Afternoon Tea menu at Parisien is a feast for the senses, featuring a carefully curated selection of culinary delights that cater to every palate. Guests can expect to enjoy a variety of freshly prepared delicate pastries, and delicate sweet treats. Pair these delectable offerings with a glass of sparkling wine for a truly indulgent experience. Each item on the menu is beautifully presented, showcasing both skilful craftsmanship and a dedication to quality ingredients that elevate the afternoon tea experience to a sophisticated level.
